title: SCHC No-Ack fragmentation mode
description:
src/fragment/no_ack.rs behind #[cfg(feature = "no-ack")]:
- NoAckSender: fragment packet into tiles, no state machine
- NoAckReceiver: collect tiles, reassemble when All-1 received
- No retransmission, no ACKs
- Simplest mode ~100 lines
- Const generic parameters: M, N, T, TILE_SIZE
